title: Compatible algebraization with supplied quotient interchange
statement: Let X be Noetherian, I,K quasi-coherent ideal sheaves and M in Coh(X,I), with positive-level quotients and completion as in [def-weil-pbc-coherent-formal-module], [pqf-def-locnoeth], [pqf-def-coherent], [lem-weil-pbc-quasi-coherent-ideal-closed-subscheme], [def-nagata-extended-ideal]. Suppose I-completion on every V(K^e), e≥1, is an equivalence. Let H be coherent and α:M→completion_I(H), with component kernels and cokernels uniformly killed by K^t for some t≥1. Supply a natural isomorphism θ_{e,n}:(H/K^(e+1)H)/I^(n+1)≅(H/I^(n+1)H)/K^(e+1) whose composite with the quotient projections agrees in both orders. Then there exist N in Coh(X,K), δ:N→completion_K(H), and a natural isomorphism σ_{e,n}:N_e/I^(n+1)N_e≅M_n/K^(e+1)M_n. For all e,n≥0, σ_{e,n} followed by the K^(e+1)-reduction of α_n equals the I^(n+1)-reduction of δ_e followed by θ_{e,n}. One positive power of K kills the kernels and cokernels of every component of δ.

proof.text: Identify coherent modules and formal systems killed by K^e with their categories on V(K^e), using the closed-immersion equivalences. Essential surjectivity of the assumed completion equivalence algebraizes each system M_n/K^e M_n. Full faithfulness uniquely lifts the transitions; quotient compatibility and reflection of isomorphisms establish the K-adic object conditions. The chosen completion comparisons assemble into σ, natural in n by construction and in e by the lifted transitions.

Reduce α modulo K^e and compose with θ inverse, giving a map to the I-completion of H/K^e H. Full faithfulness lifts it to δ_e. Faithfulness verifies the transition squares, so these maps form δ. Their defining lifted equations are precisely the σ/δ/θ comparison square.

Apply the reduction assertion of Remark 0888 to the uniform K^t bound for α, yielding K^(2t) for its K^e-reductions. On affine opens of V(K^e), use the annihilation equivalence to pass this completed bound to the lifted coherent map δ_e with bound K^(4t). These affine vanishing statements imply sheaf vanishing, uniformly for every e. Choose the positive exponent 4t.

    {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian X] (I K : X.IdealSheafData)
    (M : CoherentFormalModule X I)
    (hthick : ∀ (e : ℕ), 1 ≤ e →
      ∀ (hZ : IsNoetherian (K ^ e).subscheme),
        Functor.IsEquivalence
          (@completion ((K ^ e).subscheme) hZ (I.comap (K ^ e).subschemeι)))
    (H : CoherentModules X) (α : M ⟶ (completion X I).obj H)
    (htorsion : ∃ t : ℕ, 1 ≤ t ∧ ∀ n : ℕ,
      IsZero (Scheme.idealModuleProduct (Scheme.idealSheafPower K.toModulesι t).2
        (kernel (α.hom.app (op n)))) ∧
      IsZero (Scheme.idealModuleProduct (Scheme.idealSheafPower K.toModulesι t).2
        (cokernel (α.hom.app (op n)))))
    (θ : formalCompletionSystem K H.obj ⋙ formalCompletionFunctor I ≅
      (formalCompletionSystem I H.obj ⋙ formalCompletionFunctor K).flip)
    (hθ : ∀ e n : ℕ,
        formalModuleQuotientπ K (e + 1) H.obj ≫
          formalModuleQuotientπ I (n + 1) (formalModuleQuotient K (e + 1) H.obj) ≫
          (θ.hom.app (op e)).app (op n) =
        formalModuleQuotientπ I (n + 1) H.obj ≫
          formalModuleQuotientπ K (e + 1) (formalModuleQuotient I (n + 1) H.obj)) :
    ∃ (N : CoherentFormalModule X K) (δ : N ⟶ (completion X K).obj H)
      (σ : N.obj ⋙ formalCompletionFunctor I ≅
        (M.obj ⋙ formalCompletionFunctor K).flip),
      (∀ e n : ℕ,
        (σ.hom.app (op e)).app (op n) ≫
          formalModuleQuotientMap K (α.hom.app (op n)) (Nat.le_refl (e + 1)) =
        formalModuleQuotientMap I (δ.hom.app (op e)) (Nat.le_refl (n + 1)) ≫
          (θ.hom.app (op e)).app (op n)) ∧
      (∃ t : ℕ, 1 ≤ t ∧ ∀ e : ℕ,
        IsZero (Scheme.idealModuleProduct (Scheme.idealSheafPower K.toModulesι t).2
          (kernel (δ.hom.app (op e)))) ∧
        IsZero (Scheme.idealModuleProduct (Scheme.idealSheafPower K.toModulesι t).2
          (cokernel (δ.hom.app (op e)))))
